text:
sophie_sales: BlueHarbor POC stuck on 429s during embeddings migration. Demo in 24h. Can we triage? @dan_se @micah_eng

dan_se: Paste an error and how theyre importing (workers, batch size).

sophie_sales: Client sample: 
HTTP/1.1 429 Too Many Requests
X-RateLimit-Limit: 80
X-RateLimit-Remaining: 0
X-RateLimit-Reset: 12
{"error":{"message":"rate limit exceeded"}}
They ran 150 workers, batch_size=256. Also occasional chat enrichment calls.

micah_eng: That will blow past per-route caps. Our tenant soft_quota is 80 r/s on embeddings; token/sec estimate spikes >100k during import.

ellie_infra: Hosted shared pool -> autoscaler won't add dedicated capacity for trials. Two immediate levers: (1) ephemeral tenant bump to 160 r/s with 2h TTL, (2) enable per-route queueing (max_inflight=30) to smooth spikes.

kevin_sre: Queueing safest short-term. Bump ok if limited TTL and monitored. Also recommend client reduce batch_size to 64 and add jittered backoff.

luna_support: Quick retry snippet to send them: 
```python
for i in range(6):
    r = call_api()
    if r.status_code == 429:
        sleep((2 ** i) + random.random())
        continue
    break
```

dan_se: Sales wants pricing impact for a 2h bump. Finance: need a quick estimate.

sophie_sales: Sales will approve temporary bump if costs are reasonable. Can ops apply change?

micah_eng: I'll request change: tenant BH-401 soft_quota=160 r/s, route_queueing=true, ttl=2h.

deploy_bot: deploy_bot: "Applying config change for tenant BH-401 by micah_eng"

deploy_bot: deploy_bot: "Config applied (cfg_bh_204)"

kevin_sre: Monitoring X-RateLimit-Remaining and token/sec now. Initial rerun shows far fewer 429s. A few remain when they restart all workers simultaneously; backoff handled rest.

luna_support: I'll send a follow-up best-practices note: chunking, sequential enrichment, retry windows, and a small import runner patch.

dan_se: Action items: add a presales preflight check for large imports (>50 concurrent workers); include a recommended default batch size and guidance on demo-era bumps.

sophie_sales: Thanks team 44d Demo looks salvageable.
